title: Chapter 647
text:
"Let's end this quickly."

Wrothers's mind flashed, and a dense aura gushed out like a small star. Facing the hundreds of thousands of mechanical soldiers in the sky, he pushed his palms forward, and the dense shockwave blast turned into a dark red beam that shot toward Han Xiao, who was surrounded by the Mech Legion.

The outer layers of mechanical soldiers were directly blasted apart, and fragments flew everywhere like sand being blown away by waves.

The cannon fodder machines could not block the shockwave attack of an A + Pugilist. The four Oathkeepers moved and stood in front of the shockwave, unleashing their shields at the same time to block Fosters' shockwave attack, preventing it from advancing any further.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and his Mechanical Force swept out. Under the splashing of the [Mechanical Force Field], it covered all the mechanical soldiers. The next moment, he waved his hand, and hundreds of thousands of mechanical soldiers opened fire at the same time, forming various formations and attacking Wrothers with different tactics.

An intense battle broke out!

The huge Mech Legion drowned Wrothers, and a small battlefield appeared in the middle of the main battlefield. The surrounding fleets were still fighting each other. The Bloodshed Land did not care about one-on-one battles, and their fleets opened fire from time to time, wanting to help Wrothers destroy Black Star's Mech Legion. However, Section Zero was not to be trifled with either.

While the other Calamity Grade Supers were watching the show, they still had the guts to command their fleets to provide cover for Han Xiao.

Furthermore, the surrounding machines were all equipped with Hovering Shields, and the attacks from time to time were all blocked.

A Calamity Grade Mechanic who went all out was able to fight an entire fleet alone!

However, Han Xiao placed all his attention on Wrothers.

Millions of Ion Cannons crisscrossed like an airtight net, continuously attacking Wrothers. He dodged at times and took them head-on at times, using the high density of Pugilist flames to charge forward and tear apart mechanical soldiers one after another.

The armor of most of the conventional mechanical soldiers was like paper in front of Wrothers. In a Grade A battle, the role of the conventional army was to provide firepower and tactical control, constantly wearing down the enemy. Under the boost of Han Xiao's surging Mechanical Force, Wrothers had no choice but to dodge. Being focused on by hundreds of thousands of mechanical soldiers was not a joke.

While he was confident in his physical strength, he was still a man, and he had to treat himself better.

The main force of the battle was a small number of Grade A elite machines, such as the improved versions of the Oathkeepers and Phantoms. Their individual strength naturally could not exceed that of a Calamity Grade Super, but when they worked together, they could pose a threat to a Calamity Grade Super. Even the Chief Vanguard Official under the Tyrant, who was renowned in the Star Field, would not be able to destroy an Oathkeeper with a few punches and kicks.

Han Xiao moved among the Mech Legion at an extremely fast speed, constantly changing his position, making it difficult for Wrothers to lock onto his position.

Wrothers did not dare stop and maintained his high-speed movement, dodging the continuous attacks while analyzing the situation in his mind.

I have to find an opportunity to charge in and kill the leader, or I'll be overwhelmed by the human wave tactic.

It was not that Wrothers had not fought with an Army Style Mechanic before, but he was very clear that once he was surrounded by the Mech Legion, he would be exhausted to death sooner or later. The attack power of hundreds of thousands of mechanical soldiers was not something he could underestimate.

The weakness of an Army Style Mechanic was to charge in and kill the leader, and their body was the breakthrough point.

Black Star has the nickname of Indestructible Body … However, he can't be more difficult to deal with than the Mech Legion.

Wrothers's eyes narrowed, and his aura erupted. He used a certain ability to increase his Charge speed by many times, turning into a dark red bolt of lightning, smashing through the layers of mechanical soldiers surrounding him. He quickly approached Han Xiao's side, and his powerful fist smashed toward Han Xiao's neck.

Just as the fist was about to hit, Han Xiao's figure suddenly disappeared, and the next moment, he appeared on the other side of the Mech Legion. It was Advanced Void Travel.

Following that, Wrothers charged toward Han Xiao again and again, but he was easily dodged by Han Xiao. Void Travel, Chaos Body, Berserk Ape's short-range Space Jump module, and many other abilities were used one after another. Wrothers could not even touch the corner of his clothes, and his long-range Shockwave Blast was easily dodged.

Wrothers's expression became more and more ugly. According to the intelligence from Bloodshed Land, he had thought that Han Xiao would charge forward to fight him head-on with his strong body, and he would be able to teach him a lesson. He did not expect him to be so slippery.

Han Xiao's thoughts were very clear. After all, he was a Mechanic. Before the Mech Legion was defeated, there was no need for him to charge forward with his tankiness.

Tankiness was his trump card, and he would naturally use it last. His mission was to pin down the eight Vanguard Officials and use the Mech Legion to pin down Wrothers. That way, he would be able to attract the other Vanguard Officials to join him in dismantling his Mech Legion, and he would be able to pin down even more Vanguard Officials.

Otherwise, with just his tankiness, although Wrothers would not be able to kill him, he would definitely be suppressed and would not be able to fight back.

Han Xiao also had a long-term plan. As long as he completed this tactical mission, he would be able to obtain Cutting-Edge Knowledge and complete his Class Advancement. He would be able to defeat the Mech Legion, and he could use this as an excuse to withdraw from the battle for a period of time. He would be able to use his newly upgraded abilities to create a brand new Mech Legion.

The Amethyst Civilization would compensate him for his losses.

He knew that the expansion of Bloodshed Land was unstoppable, and with the current performance of Section Zero, they would definitely be defeated in the early stages. He did not want to fight a battle that he would definitely lose, so he might as well retreat and go home.

At that time, when the situation was bad, Purple Crystal would become anxious and take the initiative to ask him to fight. Only then would he be able to take advantage of them.

All along, although Han Xiao had been using the Army Style, he also liked to engage in close combat. However, at this time, he had chosen a proper tactic and used his amazing dodging ability to resolve Wrothers's attacks time and time again. The strength of an Army Style Mechanic was displayed to the fullest!

Although the losses of the Mech Legion were increasing, Wrothers' energy consumption was even more intense. With hundreds of thousands of mechanical soldiers, the quantity had already caused a qualitative change. With such a dense and frequent attack frequency, no one below Beyond Grade A would dare to take it head-on unless they had a special tank ability.

As for the damaged machines, Han Xiao used [Waste Modification] and [Machinery Continued] to repair them time and time again. It was as though there was no end to them.

Both parties could see that Wrothers was like a bug trapped in a net, completely falling into the rhythm of Black Star's battle. With the help of Han Xiao's high-intensity Mechanical Force and [Superhuman]'s 42% attack increase from level 170, Wrothers's individual strength advantage was greatly reduced.

"He's holding back the Chief Vanguard Official!"

Many Grade A Supers in Section Zero felt their spirits lifted.

It was good news that Black Star was able to fight against the Chief Vanguard Official.

However, no one was too surprised. Black Star was no longer a nobody, and many of his deeds had spread throughout the galaxy. Furthermore, he was the strongest member under the Dragon Emperor, so it was not surprising that he was able to fight against the Chief Vanguard Official of the Tyrant.

Ralph, on the other hand, was a little anxious. Black Star had promised him to hold back the eight Vanguard Officials, but at this moment, only Wrothers was being held back. The other Vanguard Officials were still destroying the fleet. If not for the fact that Black Star was engaged in an intense battle, he would have rushed him.

After dodging another hundred ion cannons, Wrothers looked at Han Xiao, who was moving around, and was extremely unhappy.

Black Star was far more difficult to deal with than he had expected.

Wrothers still did not feel that Black Star was a match for him. The way he saw it, victory would be his sooner or later as long as he could grab hold of the opportunity. However, the two of them had dragged on for too long, which was the opposite of his original intention of ending the battle quickly. He could not help but feel frustrated, and his patience was completely exhausted.

"Jaeger, Malekith … come and help me dismantle Black Star's Mech Legion. Let's see where he can hide!" Wrothers shouted.

The other seven Vanguard Officials who were dealing with the fleet received the order and were surprised. They knew that Wrothers had said that he would deal with Black Star alone. Why did he need help now?

The seven of them naturally gave face to their Chief. Furthermore, Black Star had just provoked them. They turned around and charged toward the small battlefield between Black Star and Wrothers, turning into seven shooting stars and smashing into the Mech Legion.

With the eight Vanguard Officials working together, the situation instantly worsened, and the Mech Legion was destroyed.

"Black Star can't hold on for much longer."

The Grade A Supers of Section Zero felt their hearts skip a beat. However, facing eight Vanguard Officials, they did not want to take the risk of supporting Black Star. Before the Mech Legion was destroyed, Black Star still had a chance to retreat.

Wrothers stared at Han Xiao. The moment Black Star showed any signs of retreating, he would immediately charge forward to interrupt him, not wanting to let Han Xiao escape.

However, out of his expectations, even though the situation was clearly deteriorating, Han Xiao continued to fight without any intention of escaping. This made Wrothers's vigilance useless.

"What is Black Star doing? Why isn't he retreating?"

"Doesn't he know that he will definitely die if he continues fighting?"

The surrounding Calamity Grade Supers were all shocked, and their faces were filled with confusion. Had Black Star gone crazy? Was he trying to fight all eight of them alone?

The sky was filled with mechanical debris, and less than a tenth of the Mech Legion remained. Wrothers and the others finally stopped and looked at Han Xiao, who had stopped as well.

Looking at the few remaining mechanical soldiers, Han Xiao remained indifferent. His opponents were eight Vanguard Officials after all, and this result was within his expectations. With just the Mech Legion, it would be difficult for him to face eight of them.

However, with the insurance, Han Xiao did not feel any heartache. Instead, he chuckled and sent a voice message to the eight Vanguard Officials.

"Hehe, in the end, all eight of you still have to come at me together."

Wrothers's face sank, and he said with a deep voice, "Hurry up and finish him off. Let's see if he can still laugh."

"Really?" Malekith was surprised.

"Since we have already started the siege, let's fight to the end," Wrothers said coldly.

The other seven did not have any unwillingness. They had only watched the one-on-one battle because of Wrothers. Now that Wrothers was no longer playing and had taken the initiative to ask them for help, they would not stop halfway. Bloodshed Land did not care about one-on-one battles. Gathering the strong to end the battle quickly was the way to go.

The eight Vanguard Officials suddenly charged forward, and Han Xiao took a deep breath and faced them head-on. In the eyes of the surrounding Calamity Grade Supers, Black Star's back was inexplicably dyed with the aura of someone who was not afraid of death.

Everyone was moved!

They did not understand why Black Star would risk his life so much, not hesitating to give it up!

The eight meteors hit Han Xiao's body again and again, and the fiery punches left countless afterimages, bombarding every inch of his body.

How many punches did Black Star receive? The spectators could not even count.

Everyone felt a sense of desolation and could not bear to watch anymore. Black Star would definitely be torn apart by the eight Vanguard Officials like a sheep in a pack of tigers.

However, the next moment, they rubbed their eyes and could not believe what they were seeing!

Although Han Xiao was in a sorry state, flying here and there, and even his mechanical suit was shattered, his body was still strong, and he was still so lively after taking countless punches!

Fosters and the others stopped abruptly and looked at Han Xiao in the middle with bewilderment.

The energy that they had just unleashed was enough to destroy half of the surface of a medium-sized planet. Black Star was actually still alive?

"The energy conversion is indeed reliable, and the Steel Body has reduced a lot of the True Damage. However, the damage of these guys is really terrifying. I almost had to use Aurora's Character Summon Card."

Although he was being suppressed, Han Xiao had been calmly analyzing the situation.

Seeing that the eight of them had stopped, Han Xiao sighed, rubbed his neck, and revealed a nonchalant smile. However, it was more effective than any provocation. Wrothers' face instantly turned green. He felt that this smile was filled with mockery and sarcasm, as though it was saying, "Why did you stop?"

At this moment, everyone's expression seemed to have frozen.

Ralph's face was filled with joy. Black Star was really able to withstand the attacks of the eight Vanguard Officials. He was serious!

The many Grade A Supers of Section Zero were shocked. Those eight enemies were not ordinary Calamity Grade Supers but the famous eight Vanguard Officials of the Bloodshed Land. Their names were known throughout the entire Star Field!

Wrothers and the others were filled with shock and anger. The eight of them had only lost to the Tyrant Heber before!

They could not believe that Han Xiao had actually withstood their attacks.

It was as though an unstoppable wave had smashed into a cliff and exploded!

Black Star's name appeared in everyone's mind, forming a thought that they could not get rid of.

Was this the rumored … Indestructible Body?

…
